title: Vaelric, an oath-bound knight boss from my painted Souls-like
author: Spildrejorde
selftext:
Hey all! Here's a boss fight from **The Rootbound**, a small dark-fantasy  game I'm making in Godot. It's still early, so expect rough edges.

Vaelric is the last knight of an order guarding a mountain pass. He tells you to turn back, and you don't. Phase one is a straight sword duel. In phase two his oath breaks and he switches to ice: thrown rime shards, a big hailfall, and frost creeping over the floor.

**Art style:** hand-painted with ink outlines. I want it to look like concept art you can walk around in.

**How it's made:** I design the world, story and the mechanics, and the AI tools build to my direction. I have little to no experience in any of this work, but this is a fun way to bring my ideas to life.  
  
\- Claude writes the code. I play, send notes with marked-up screenshots, and it reworks.  
\- The models come from AI 3D generators. Claude rigs and animates them in Blender by script, and I fix some animations by hand.  
\- The music and speech is Suno, and the sound effects come from free sound libraries.

The biggest lesson so far: Claude Code makes stuff fast but it is usually rough. I have to manually adjust some animations and spend a lot of time trying to explain what feels off.

I've been at it every day for about 2 months now. It's a passion project, made purely for fun.

How does it look?

comments.author: thorhal
comments.body: I really like it, keep going.
